present_illness.present_illness: Deny the history of systemic diseases, infectious diseases and drug allergies. Health code green, body temperature is normal, deny the history of travel to epidemic risk areas within 14 days, deny the history of close contact with COVID-19 patients.

past_history.present_illness: Deny the history of systemic diseases, infectious diseases and drug allergies. Health code green, body temperature is normal, deny the history of travel to epidemic risk areas within 14 days, deny the history of close contact with COVID-19 patients.

oral_examination.oral_examination: The gums of the whole mouth are red and swollen, easy to bleed, and the periodontal pocket is not reached. Tartar (+), dental surface pigment.

treatment_plan.notes: Do not eat acidic food for a week, avoid hot and cold stimulation. Regular medical advice is to maintain oral hygiene and use mouthwash. Regular review, discomfort follow-up.
